atomic_facts.fact: First Brands Group entered Chapter 7 bankruptcy liquidation.
The Chapter 7 bankruptcy liquidation occurred as of September 1, 2026.
First Brands Group initiated voluntary U.S. Chapter 11 bankruptcy cases.
The Chapter 11 initiation was announced in a press release dated September 28, 2025.
First Brands Group is a supplier of automotive aftermarket parts.
First Brands Group is a global (worldwide-operating) supplier.
First Brands Group was founded in 2013.
First Brands Group was founded in Ohio.
First Brands Group was originally named Crowne Group.
First Brands Group's headquarters is located in Cleveland, Ohio.
First Brands Group's headquarters is located in the United States.
